verdict.rationale: Devin documents a first-party API for integrating Devin and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of users. Its official MCP server claims full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge and scheduling, which together cover a substantial share of UI functions programmatically. Nothing explicitly claims UI–API parity, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage of UI-only features (such as the embedded IDE takeover, review/Auto-Fix configuration and org settings like desktop mode), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
you can create sessions on behalf of any user in your organization using the create_as_user_id parameter
it gives any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling
